note: Poppler loads the embedded TrueType font from the PDF with face_index 0, creating an FT_Face for the attacker-controlled font data.
The embedded font contains a valid fvar table, so the face is marked as supporting font variations.
Because fvar, glyf, and gvar tables are all present, FT_FACE_FLAG_MULTIPLE_MASTERS is set on the face.
The variation blend structure is allocated when MM data is requested, enabling the variation code path.
The unrounded pointer is set to the glyph loader's extra_points2 array, which is not initialized for this glyph.
TT_Vary_Apply_Glyph_Deltas is called with the uninitialized extra_points2 array as the unrounded output buffer.
The gvar table for the glyph has an invalid header where offsetToData exceeds dataSize, so the function returns an error without writing any values into the unrounded array.
After TT_Vary_Apply_Glyph_Deltas returns an error, the code reads unrounded[n_points-3] before checking the error, consuming uninitialized memory from extra_points2.
The code reads unrounded[n_points-4] which is also uninitialized, propagating the uninitialized value.
The code reads unrounded[n_points-1] from the uninitialized extra_points2 array.

The code reads unrounded[n_points-2] from the uninitialized extra_points2 array, and these uninitialized values are later used in scaling arithmetic, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value report.
